bind_host.description: Network interface to bind the Gnocchi REST API to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only).

bind_port.description: TCP port for the Gnocchi API service.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave blank to log to stdout/stderr instead.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Recommended: INFO for production, DEBUG for troubleshooting.

auth_url.description: Keystone auth endpoint (must include version, e.g., /v3).

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name used for service credentials.

password.description: Keystone service user password (should be set securely, e.g., via config management).

driver.description: Storage backend to use. 'file' is simplest for testing; others require extra dependencies.

file_basepath.description: Directory for local file storage (only used if driver='file').

indexer_url.description: Database URL for the indexer backend (SQLAlchemy format).

metricd_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the metricd service (handles metric processing).

coordination_url.description: URL for distributed locking (e.g., file, redis, or memcached). Required for HA deployments.

batch_size.description: Number of metrics to process per batch (trade-off between latency and throughput).

statsd.description: StatsD ingestion settings (for accepting metrics from statsd clients).

resource_id.description: Resource UUID to associate ingested statsd metrics with (optional but recommended in multi-tenant setups).

user_id.description: User ID to assign to statsd-ingested metrics (for authorization).

project_id.description: Project ID to assign to statsd-ingested metrics.
